topic: What is addiction and how does it work?

selected_primary_idea.title: Addiction Mechanism and Memory-Control Atlas
selected_primary_idea.abstract: A longitudinal multimodal and causal framework that separates reward learning, wanting, liking, habit, withdrawal, executive control, cue-memory reactivation, and gene-environment context to predict and safely modify relapse mechanisms.
selected_primary_idea.research_object: Dynamic addiction-related brain-behavior-environment states and their relation to compulsive seeking, treatment response, and relapse
selected_primary_idea.mechanism: Repeated substance exposure and learned cues alter reward, stress, habit, memory, and control systems, with person-specific interactions among biology, development, environment, and treatment.
selected_primary_idea.intervention: Computational latent-state perturbation followed, only after approval, by mechanism-specific treatment or neural modulation studies; no intervention executed in this artifact.
falsification_conditions: mechanisms cannot be separated from arousal and state
cue memory adds no held-out predictive value
prediction relies on demographic or clinic proxy leakage

high_risk_ideas.title: Subject-specific mechanism controller
high_risk_ideas.value: Tests whether relapse prevention improves when target mechanisms rather than substance labels guide care

rejected_ideas.title: Dopamine-only addiction
rejected_ideas.reason: Ignores stress, withdrawal, habit, executive control, memory, and environment

rejected_ideas.title: Artificial memory as addiction cure
rejected_ideas.reason: Confuses a constrained memory manipulation paradigm with human treatment and subjective recovery

rejected_ideas.title: Static genetic destiny score
rejected_ideas.reason: Turns probabilistic gene-environment risk into a deterministic and potentially discriminatory label

mcts_trace.defect: addiction is framed as willpower failure
dopamine is treated as a complete explanation
mcts_trace.edit: separate wanting, liking, habit, withdrawal, and control

mcts_trace.defect: memory manipulation is overclaimed as transplant or cure
mcts_trace.edit: treat cues and memory as one endpoint with independent subjective and behavioral measures
add individual trajectory, gene-environment moderation, fairness, and clinical safety gates
